name: Nicomac Taikisha Cleanrooms Pvt. Ltd
india_angle: Nicomac Taikisha Clean Rooms Pvt. Ltd. is one of the most modern and efficient cleanroom manufacturers in Asia, with a presence in India.
summary: Nicomac Taikisha Clean Rooms Pvt. Ltd. provides turnkey cleanroom solutions, including design, manufacturing, installation, and validation services, for the semiconductor and other high-tech industries. Their expertise in modular cleanroom systems and HVAC solutions supports semiconductor manufacturing facilities in maintaining controlled environments.
